page.layout: One page of text, photographed on an open book at an angle. Running head at top centre with page number at top left. Main text block of italic lines at upper right, closing signature block centred right, then a signed name line, and a catchword-like fragment "PRO" at lower right cut off by the edge. No margin notes.

p.i: gratam, Vestro etiam inclyto fauore ac patrocinio non indignam iudicabo; Cui simul Me meaque studia spe bona voveo atque commendo, Deum inuocaturus, ut vestris consiliis clementer adesse ac benedicere dignetur, ad suiipsius gloriam vestram ciuiumq; salutem, tranquillitatem, prosperitatem. Dabam Monspelii, VIII. Junii anno MDCXI.
V. V. Magnif. ac Spectabil. humilimus cliens

page.notes: The scan is cropped at the right edge, so line ends are cut off (for example "ad" and "hu-" and "Col-" lines). The word "PRO" at the lower right is cut off by the edge and may continue as PRO-something. Some words at the line ends, such as "adesse" and "tranquillita-", are partly hidden by the edge of the page. Several lines are reconstructed from partly visible letters. The "Col-" line is also cropped.
